Maya (sec-eng): quick sync idea — we need a tiny, automatable onboarding gate for customer-facing audit delivery (webhook, S3 export, SIEM endpoints). goal: minimize hand-holding and catch common misconfigurations early.
Jonathan (eng-runtime): agreed. propose 3 checks: schema shape, signature verification, and KMS envelope roundtrip. keep schema minimal.
Alice (devex): consumer feedback: most backends only need actor.id, action, resource.id, outcome, and request_id. if those 5 fields are stable we can write simple ingestion parsers.
Prateek (sre): operational items: S3 export ordering guarantees (we write hourly bundles, each with manifest.json and _SUCCESS marker), gzip per object, manifest lists object keys + encrypted_dek + kms_key_id. doc this precisely.
audit-bot: infra: schema-checker v0.13 promoted to staging at 2026-03-18T15:04:12Z.
Maya (sec-eng): draft webhook payload for validation harness (please eyeball signature header and KMS metadata):

```json
{
  "event_type": "deployment.model",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T15:00:00Z",
  "request_id": "req_aa12ef",
  "actor.id": "team-88",
  "resource.id": "model-abc",
  "action": "promote",
  "outcome": "success",
  "details.version": "v3.0",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444555666:key/rot-01",
  "encrypted_dek": "base64(...)",
  "encryption": "kms+aesgcm",
  "schema_version": "audit_v1"
}
```

Maya (sec-eng): header convention: `X-RW-Signature: sha256=<hex>` computed over the raw payload using the webhook secret. onboarding harness will POST a sample payload and expect customer to validate signature.
Jonathan (eng-runtime): S3 export notes: path layout `s3://redwood-audit/<cust_id>/YYYY/MM/DD/HH/manifest.json`. each manifest entry includes `key`, `size`, `gzip: true`, `encrypted_dek`, `kms_key_id`. we atomically write manifest then `_SUCCESS` so consumers can rely on manifest completeness. also include a small test fixture showing expected manifest shape in docs.
Alice (devex): SIEM/HEC mapping examples: provide a tiny Splunk HEC example and a Datadog log intake example. Splunk HEC minimal payload: `{ "time": 1700009999, "event": { "event_type":"deployment.model","request_id":"req_aa12ef","actor":"team-88","action":"promote","outcome":"success" } }`. include a note about setting `source` and `sourcetype`.
Prateek (sre): KMS rotation and decrypt test: onboarding harness will attempt to decrypt `encrypted_dek` by calling customer KMS (with provided ARN and temporary decrypt permissions). if decrypt fails, fail the gate and raise a support ticket. add metric `audit.onboard.decrypt_failures_total`.
Maya (sec-eng): vuln-triage / monitoring: if deliveries for a customer drop below expected (missing hourly manifests) automatically create incident P2 and attach last-known manifest + sample payloads. this avoids silent data loss.
Jonathan (eng-runtime): proposed automated onboarding tests (to run from CI or run_once script):
- jsonschema validation against `audit_v1`
- POST to webhook URL and verify `X-RW-Signature` verification path
- KMS decrypt roundtrip using `encrypted_dek` and `kms_key_id`
- S3 manifest presence and `_SUCCESS` check for a generated hourly bundle
- Splunk HEC smoke POST (if customer provides HEC token & endpoint)

Maya (sec-eng): customer checklist (one-line items to confirm during self-serve or assisted onboarding):
- webhook URL + secret provided (or opt-out)
- KMS ARN supplied (or opt-out); verify permissions for decrypt test
- S3 bucket and IAM policy agreed for exports, retention window confirmed
- run `redwood-audit-validate.sh` and share results

Alice (devex): I'll draft a short quickstart and example Kibana/Splunk queries. also include a tiny Node/Python snippet that verifies `X-RW-Signature`.
Prateek (sre): I'll add the decrypt check and manifest check to `infra/testing/audit` and expose Prom metrics. filing INF-4827 to track work and owners.
Jonathan (eng-runtime): I'll add jsonschema to `pkg/audit/schema` and a small `validate_onboard.sh`. will add test fixtures (sample webhook secret, dummy kms key id pattern, sample HEC token) behind feature-flag.
Maya (sec-eng): can @Jonathan and @Prateek pair to land the harness and PR to docs? target: EOW.
Prateek (sre): ack. I'll create the alert runbook for missing manifests and link to incident playbook.
Maya (sec-eng): thanks all. keep PR links and any failing validation outputs in INF-4827. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
